body_markdown:
Filed under[Recent Investor News](https://compxinternational.com/category/recent-investor-news/) on Nov 04, 2026


Dallas, Texas, Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — CompX International Inc. (NYSE American: CIX) announced today that its board of directors has declared CompX’s regular quarterly dividend of thirty cents ($0.30) per share on its class A common stock, payable on December 8, 2026 to stockholders of record at the close of business on November 19, 2026.


CompX is a leading manufacturer of security products, recreational marine components and custom metal fabricated parts.
